notes: *the king's seer* is an English possessive: rule 29's possessive case gives the phrase's *the* to the article on the rectum and leaves the construct its bare noun, nothing being fronted.

In *was of Jehovah* the single *of* is assigned to the fused `בְיַד`, since the clause writes only one relational word; giving it instead to the name would leave the fused predicate holding only the copula.
The supplied *in* of *in the house of Jehovah* is licensed by the locative accusative and belongs to the noun (rule 33), no preposition standing on it.
